_comment: Balanced-but-partial tuning: the projection attack WITH the graded injection. Projection alone saturates (192/192 full) because it sets the ranking from vectors, overriding passage text; but with the graded alignment the injected vectors differ in strength too, so projection may spread them across the boundary. If it does, this is the configuration the validation needs: the projection attack is the balanced one, and the grading supplies the partial.
